source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
As [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, you can pick one of these:

- **Eliminate At All Costs**: pick an enemy unit anywhere on the battlefield. Attacks by your **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** models against it get +1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) until your next Command phase.
- **Acquire At All Costs**: pick an [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) anywhere on the battlefield. While one of your **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** units is in range of it, that unit's models get +1 Ld, +1 OC and a 5+ invulnerable save until your next Command phase.
